splash.subtitle: Home Edition
setup.title: DeskOS 98 Setup
setup.welcome: Welcome! Before you can look for a job, DeskOS needs to know who you are. It will not ask for a password. It has trust issues, but not with you.
setup.age_confirmed: I am at least 16 years old
setup.sent_body: We sent a sign-in link to your e-mail address. Click it to continue. It expires soon, like most good intentions.
setup.invalid_link: That sign-in link is expired or was already used. Please request a new one.
setup.error_email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
setup.error_age: You must be at least 16 years old to play.
redeem.title: Signing you in
redeem.body: Checking your badge with security. Please look natural.
log_off.title: Log Off
log_off.message: Are you sure you want to log off? Your unfinished business will wait for you. It always does.
shut_down.safe: It's now safe to turn off your computer.
shut_down.note: Your problems will still be there tomorrow.
my_computer.title: System Properties
my_computer.hardware: Pentium-ish 75MHz, 16 MB RAM, one sticky key
control_panel.title: Regional Settings
control_panel.language_hint: Your desktop is shown in this language. You can only apply to companies that speak it.
recycle_bin.denied_message: These files are protected by the Emotional Attachment Act.
worknet.error: Connection lost. The modem needs a moment. Please try again.
worknet.empty: No open positions in your language right now. The economy is resting.
worknet.message_placeholder: Tell them why you are the one. Or at least available.
worknet.status_detail.pending: Your application is on its way. The company will answer by mail.
worknet.status_detail.accepted: You got this job. Congratulations! The details are in your mail.
worknet.sent_message: Your application to :company has been transmitted. Companies usually answer by mail within a few minutes. Keep an eye on your inbox.
worknet.refusal.language_mismatch: This company only reads applications in its own language.
worknet.refusal.already_employed: You already have a job. WorkNet 98 does not support moonlighting. Yet.
worknet.refusal.already_applied: You already applied for this position. Applying twice does not make it faster. We checked.
worknet.refusal.application_pending: You already have an application waiting for an answer. WorkNet 98 allows one application at a time, for everyone's nerves.
inbox.subject: Subject
inbox.empty: No messages. Nobody writes to you. Yet.
inbox.select: Select a message to read it.
game_mail.offer.subject: Your application as :job
game_mail.offer.body:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your application as :job. We are delighted to inform you that you got the job! Congratulations and welcome to :company.

Your salary is :salary credits per day. Details about your first shift will follow shortly.

:note

Kind regards,
:contact
Human Resources, :company
mail.login_link.subject: Your sign-in link for DeskLife 98
mail.login_link.heading: Your computer is waiting
mail.login_link.intro: Somebody (hopefully you) asked to sign in to DeskLife 98. Click the button below and your desktop will boot right up.
mail.login_link.expiry: This link works once and expires in :minutes minutes.
mail.login_link.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this e-mail. Nothing happens. Which is also how most meetings end.
